notes: Contexts replace required, multiple, default, settings and option constraints in their scope; most specific matching tier wins.

facts: The Endpoints table names the five existing context CRUD operations; the seeded Default context is explicitly readable, updateable and deleteable through those same operations.

The introduction describes automatic Default context creation with workspace property creation; Options belong to a context describes property option creation targeting the all-projects/all-types context and inline options on context create/update.
Wildcard flags and explicit project/type lists describe scope validation; four-tier matching chooses one context without merging. There is no resolve or preview endpoint on this page.
Options omitted during context update are removed with recorded values. Contexts require workspace properties, workspace-mode writes and workspace property scopes.
